camerao.config.title: Camerao settings
camerao.config.mode.tooltip:
How the perspective key behaves.
Hold: look around only while holding the key.
Toggle: press once to start, press again to stop.
camerao.config.perspective.tooltip:
The view used while the perspective is active.
Example: 'Third person back' shows yourself from behind, like a regular third person camera.
camerao.config.max_yaw.tooltip:
Yaw is the horizontal turn - left and right.
While active, you can only turn this far from where you started.
Example: 90 lets you turn 90 left or 90 right.
360 = no limit.
camerao.config.max_pitch.tooltip:
Pitch is the vertical look - up and down.
While active, you can only look this far up or down from the center.
Example: 45 lets you look 45 up or 45 down.
90 = full vanilla range.
camerao.config.invert_y.tooltip:
Swaps mouse up and down while the perspective is active.
Enable if moving the mouse up looks down instead.
camerao.config.smooth_camera.tooltip:
Uses vanilla cinematic smoothing while the perspective is active.
The camera drifts softly instead of following the mouse 1:1.
camerao.config.zoom_out.tooltip:
While the perspective is active, scroll to move the camera closer or further away.
Scroll down to pull the camera out, scroll up to bring it back.
camerao.config.zoom_in_limit.tooltip:
Closest camera distance while scroll zooming.
Example: 2 stops the camera 2 blocks from your body.
camerao.config.zoom_out_limit.tooltip:
Furthest camera distance while scroll zooming.
Example: 32 lets you pull the camera 32 blocks away.
camerao.config.zoom_factor.tooltip:
Zoom strength when you press the zoom key.
Example: 300 zooms to 3x. 100 = no zoom.
camerao.config.show_zoom_indicator.toolt:
Shows a number above the hotbar while zooming.
Example: 100% means no zoom, 300% means 3x zoom.
camerao.config.invert_scroll.tooltip:
Swaps the scroll direction for zooming and freecam speed.
Off: scroll down zooms in, scroll up makes the freecam faster.
On: the opposite.
camerao.config.freecam_mode.tooltip:
How the freecam key behaves.
Toggle: press once to start, press again to stop.
Hold: freecam stays on while the key is held.
camerao.config.freecam_collision.tooltip:
When enabled, the camera stops at blocks instead of flying through them.
Off: fly through anything.
camerao.config.freecam_keep_sneak.toolti:
If you activate freecam while sneaking, your player stays crouched
until you leave freecam, even though your keys control the camera.
camerao.config.freecam_exit_on_damage.to:
Leaves freecam as soon as your body takes damage,
so you are back in control when attacked.
While in freecam your body also ignores knockback,
so attackers cannot push it around.
Off: stay in freecam when hit.
camerao.config.who_am_i.tooltip:
Shows your own player name tag while playing.
Off hides it again, like vanilla.
camerao.config.show_in_inventory.tooltip:
Also shows your name tag while the inventory or another container is open.
Only has an effect while Show own name tag is on.
